infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace the 01:47 Central to Newcastle Interchange service from Central to Hornsby
infoLinks.content:
Thursday 16 and Friday 17 July  
  • Buses replace the 01:47 Central to Newcastle Interchange service from Central to Hornsby.
  • Replacement buses leave Central at 01:21, 26 minutes earlier than the normal train timetable.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
 
Bus route:
92T9  Central, express to Hornsby
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Tweed bus changes from Monday 29 June
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 29 June, we'll be making some changes to bus services in the Tweed. 
  • These improvements will support better access to Tweed Valley Hospital, improve cross-border connectivity at Tweed Mall and provide bus services for new housing growth in Kings Forest.
  • Plan your trip for real time, up to date information.
Changes to route 609:
  • New timetable and route path change.
  • New weekend and evening services with access to Tweed Valley Hospital. 
All services extended beyond Tweed Valley Hospital to Kingscliff shops at Pearl Street. 
 
See the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Leppington and Glenfield
infoLinks.content:
Monday 30 and Tuesday 31 March
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Leppington and Glenfield.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Macarthur, Glenfield and the City via Granville.
  • Buses also replace T8 Airport & South Line trains between Glenfield, Sydenham and Central via the Airport.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus route
9T2 Leppington, Edmondson Park, Glenfield and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines weekend full closure due to maintenance
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 18 and Sunday 19 July
  • L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines light rail services will not run due to planned trackwork.
  • During this time, use alternative transport including:
  • Replacement bus services or regular bus services between Central Chalmers Street and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford
  • Trains, or walk if able to, between Circular Quay and Central Chalmers Street.
Replacement bus services:
  • Replacement bus services between Central Chalmers Street and Randwick and Juniors Kingsford
    will run every 10 to 15 minutes from 5am to 1am daily. These times may vary depending on road
    traffic.
  • Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:
    • Surry Hills (in both directions) - Please use the alternative stop at Central Chalmers
      Street (approx. 8 minute walk),
    • Wansey Road (towards Central) - Please use the alternative stop at Royal Randwick
      (approx. 12 minute walk),
    • UNSW High Street (in both directions) - Please use the alternative stop at Randwick
      (approx. 10 minute walk).
  • Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service.
  • Where the replacement bus has an Opal reader onboard, you must tap on and tap off. A standard
    light rail fare applies.
  • Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is
    affected.
  • L2 and L3 light rail services will resume as normal from 5am Monday 20 July.

infoLinks.content:

As an interim solution for school students in the Dorrigo and Bellingen area, a fleet of minibuses will operate school services via the detour on Summervilles Road.
From Monday 9 February, a phased approach has commenced for school bus services. Families should stay abreast of communication being distributed via their schools.
Sign up for SMS updates about interim bus service cancellations
Inclement weather and road conditions have the potential to prevent interim bus movements on the detour route and cancel services.
Transport has set up an SMS service to notify families of cancellations of services. Opt in to receive SMS via this link.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace some trains
infoLinks.content:
Monday 6 July   
  • From 8am to 1pm, buses replace trains between Newcastle Interchange and Telarah or Muswellbrook.
  • The 08:29 Newcastle Interchange to Dungog will not run. Catch the 08:48 Newcastle Interchange to Telarah train and change at Maitland for a bus towards Dungog.
  • Buses also replace the 10:02 Dungog to Newcastle Interchange service.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
  • 1HU  Newcastle Interchange, all stations to Telarah and return
  • 4HU  Maitland, all stations to Dungog (in that direction only)
  • 7HU  Warabrook Station to University shuttle bus
  • 15HU  Maitland, all stations to Muswellbrook (in that direction only)
  • 19HU  Dungog, all stations to Maitland, Victoria Street, all stations to Beresfield, Warabrook, all stations to Newcastle Interchange (in that direction only)
  • 28HU  Muswellbrook, all stations to Maitland, Victoria Street, all stations to Beresfield, Warabrook, all stations to Newcastle Interchange (in that direction only)
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace Inner West trains between Strathfield and Central. Trains run to a changed stopping pattern
infoLinks.content:
Monday 13 and Tuesday 14 July  
  • Nightly from 9.20pm to 1.30am, buses replace Inner West trains between Strathfield and Central. Express trains continue to run. 
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Leppington and Olympic Park. Change trains at Lidcombe to continue your journey. 
  • T1 Western Line trains make extra stops at Flemington, Homebush and Burwood. Some T9 Northern Line trains make extra stops at Croydon and Ashfield.  
  • Trackwork on the City Circle may also affect how you travel. For travel in the City use T4 Eastern Suburbs Line trains, metro, light rail, local buses or walk. 
     
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.  
Bus routes 
  • 44T2 Strathfield, all stations to Stanmore, Central and return 
  • 47T2  Strathfield, all stations to Central and return 
Replacement buses 
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket. 
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker. 
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Tweed bus changes from Monday 29 June
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 29 June, we'll be making some changes to bus services in the Tweed. 
  • These improvements will support better access to Tweed Valley Hospital, improve cross-border connectivity at Tweed Mall and provide bus services for new housing growth in Kings Forest.
  • Plan your trip for real time, up to date information.
Changes to route 605:
  • New timetable and route path change.
  • Doubling of service frequency from every 2 hours to every hour, and an additional 111 services per week.
  • 605 services will no longer travel via Keith Compton Drive and will instead stay on Wharf Street. Keith Compton Drive area will instead be serviced by route 606 services. Route 606 will service Florence Street, Powell Street, Solander Street, Banks Avenue, Keith Compton Drive and Brett Street. Alternatively passengers have the option to walk to Wharf Street to access more frequent bus services, including route 605. 
See the news article for more information.

If travelling onto Goulburn, or other Opal enabled station along the Southern Highlands Line, you should not tap off when transferring from Coach to an Intercity train but instead tap off at your destination station.

Booking is not required for Opal customers on this route.

infoLinks.urlText: Lilyfield Light Rail lift is not available from 15 June
infoLinks.content:
• The lift at Lilyfield Light Rail stop will be out of service from 15 June until further notice while replacement works are carried out. The outage is expected to continue for at least five weeks.
  • During this period, access to the light rail stop will be available only via stairs, if you are able to do so safely.
  • Customer requiring lift access should use the nearest accessible light rail stop at Leichhardt North.
  • To get to Leichardt North stop, from the Lilyfield stop, take the local 437 bus route from the Balmain Rd after Lilyfield Rd stop, exit at the Norton St after City West Link stop and walk to the Leichhardt North light rail stop to catch the light rail.
  • Please allow extra travel time and plan ahead, using the Trip Planner and checking travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.

infoLinks.urlText: Changes to school bus services in Lithgow
infoLinks.content:

  • Some students may have different times for their bus service or a slightly longer walk to their bus stop. 
  • Some students attending Blue Mountains Grammar will travel in the mornings by bus from Hartley Vale to Lithgow train station and transfer to a train to Wentworth Falls. 
  • Some students attending Blue Mountains Grammar will travel in the mornings by train from Blackheath station to Wentworth Falls station.  
  • Journey times are subject to traffic volumes. 
  • Check the Trip Planner for the latest.

Journey times are subject to traffic volumes. 
Check the Trip Planner for the latest.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace Inner West trains between Strathfield and Central
infoLinks.content:
Friday 10 July
  • From 10.40pm, buses replace Inner West trains between Strathfield and Central.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Liverpool and Lidcombe only.
  • Change trains at Lidcombe to continue your journey.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
44T2  Strathfield, all stations to Stanmore, express to Central and return
47T2  Strathfield, all stations to Central and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Bus changes across Western Sydney from 5 July
infoLinks.content:
From Sunday 5 July, we’ll be making changes to some bus services across Western Sydney. 
  • Transport for NSW is introducing new bus services to connect Penrith, Oran Park, Campbelltown, Liverpool, Mount Druitt and Leppington with local centres, the new Western Sydney International Airport*, and in the future, to the emerging Bradfield City Centre.
  • New routes 772, 790, 825, 840, 845, 849 and 860 will deliver better connections 7 days a week for Western Sydney, linking communities to employment hubs, transport and essential services with frequent, reliable, and sustainable transport.
  • To find out more, read the news article and visit Bus changes at Transport or New Bus Services for Western Sydney.
*Passenger services will commence in October 2026.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Bomaderry and Wollongong
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 18 and Sunday 19 July   
  • Buses replace trains between Bomaderry and Wollongong.
  • Trains run between Port Kembla, Wollongong and Bondi Junction, some to a changed timetable.
  • Buses do not run to the train timetable. If connecting with trains at Wollongong you may need to catch an earlier bus to ensure you meet your train connection.

  • Monday, buses also replace the 02:39 Kiama to Bondi Junction service from Kiama to Wollongong.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
61SC Bomaderry, all stations to Kiama, then express to Wollongong and return
62SC Kiama, all stations to Wollongong and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Hornsby and Epping. City Circle trackwork may affect how you travel
infoLinks.content:
Monday 13 and Tuesday 14 July
  • Nightly from 9.40pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Hornsby and Epping.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Epping and Central, platforms 1-14 only. Some trains make extra stops at Croydon and Ashfield.
  • Trackwork on the City Circle may also affect how you travel. Use metro services between Epping and the City or change at Central for T4 Eastern Suburbs Line trains, metro, light rail, local buses or walk to continue your journey.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
8T9  Hornsby, express to Epping and return
82T9  Hornsby, all stations to Epping and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Tweed bus changes from Monday 29 June
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 29 June, we'll be making some changes to bus services in the Tweed. 
  • These improvements will support better access to Tweed Valley Hospital, improve cross-border connectivity at Tweed Mall and provide bus services for new housing growth in Kings Forest.
  • Plan your trip for real time, up to date information.
Changes to route 601:
  • New timetable and minor route path change.
  • 8 additional services per week, including additional weekday evening services to better suit shift times at Tweed Valley Hospital.
  • Extended from Tweed Valley Hospital to Kings Forest. 
  • Kings Forest residents have a new way to access TAFE NSW Kingscliff campus.
  • A change in Kingscliff town will see route 601 service Sutherland Street.
Every second route 601 service will terminate at Tweed City Shopping Centre. Passengers wanting to continue travel to Tweed Mall can take select route 601 services or change to other bus services at Tweed City Shopping Centre (routes 600, 603, 605, 606).  

See the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Tweed bus changes from Monday 29 June
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 29 June, we'll be making some changes to bus services in the Tweed. 
  • These improvements will support better access to Tweed Valley Hospital, improve cross-border connectivity at Tweed Mall and provide bus services for new housing growth in Kings Forest.
  • Plan your trip for real time, up to date information.
Changes to route 603:
  • New timetable and route path change.
  • 8 additional services per week.
  • All services extended between Tweed City Shopping Centre and Tweed Mall.
  • A change in Kingscliff town will see the route 603 service Moss Street and Marine Parade.
  • Tweed City Shopping Centre will be serviced on Minjungbal Drive. 
See the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Sutherland Shire bus diversions for Sutherland 2 Surf event
infoLinks.content:
Sunday 19 July
  • From 7am to 10.45am, route 961, 967, 970, 977 and 978 buses between Sutherland and Cronulla will start and end trips at different stops while roads closures are in place for the Sutherland2Surf fun run event. Stops on the Kingsway will be missed.
Services affected include:
  • Route 961: 7:58 service from Barden Ridge will operate to Sutherland Stand D (2232203) at 8:22 then divert via Linden, The Grand Pde, Glencoe, Clio, Toronto, Old Princes Hwy, President and Kiora Rd.
  • Route 967: 8:26 service from Mirada will commence at Carvers Rd & Bates Dr, Oyster Bay (222529) at 8:37 instead. Stops from Miranda to Oyster Bay will be missed.
  • Route 970: 8:42 service from Mirada will commence at Princes Hwy at Young St, Sylvania (222443) at 8:54 instead. Stops between Miranda and Sylvania will be missed.
  • Route 977: 8:00 and 9:00 loop service from Miranda will divert via Kiora Rd, President Av, Willarong Rd, Caringbah Rd and Port Hacking Rd.
  • Route 978: 8:16 service from Hay Ave Shops, Caringbah to Miranda will now commence at Caringbah South Preschool (2229168) at 8:24. The return service will not operate via Hay Ave shops
     
 
Bus customers should allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. Visit the Sutherland2Surf event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - International Airport
infoLinks.content:

Customers travelling to the Airport from the City that require a lift (wheelchair customers, prams etc.) will need to travel to Wolli Creek and catch a train back to International Airport. 

Baggage handlers will be available to assist with luggage via the escalators.

infoLinks.urlText: Tweed bus changes from Monday 29 June
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 29 June, we'll be making some changes to bus services in the Tweed. 
  • These improvements will support better access to Tweed Valley Hospital, improve cross-border connectivity at Tweed Mall and provide bus services for new housing growth in Kings Forest.
  • Plan your trip for real time, up to date information.
Changes to route 606:
  • New timetable and route path change.
  • Services to/from Fingal Head extended between Tweed Mall and Tweed City Shopping Centre, with 46 additional services per week. 
Fingal Head and Banora Point passengers can access Tweed City Shopping Centre from Minjungbal Drive. All other route 606 services will enter the Tweed City Shopping Centre carpark for the start and end of services.

See the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Parramatta Rd - Burwood, permanent bus stop closures
infoLinks.content:
Sydney Metro West construction work at Burwood will permanently close the following bus stops:
 
From 4am Monday, 4 April 2022
  • Parramatta Rd before Burwood Rd (213412) will be closed.
    The alternative stop for 415, 461X, 461N and 530 services will be Burwood Rd at Esher Lane (213431).
  • Parramatta Rd after Burwood Rd (213722) will be closed.
    The alternative stop for 415, 416X, 461N and 530 services will be Burwood Rd before Parramatta Rd (213462).

From 6am Monday 4 April 2022:
  • Parramatta Rd before Burwood Rd (213412) will be closed.
    Customers for the N70, N71, N80 and N81 services should use the new stop on Parramatta Rd, after Burwood Rd (213460).
  • Parramatta Rd after Burwood Rd (213722) will be closed.
    Customers for the N70, N71, N80 and N81 towards City Town Hall should use the alternate stop on Parramatta Rd opp Neichs Pde (213721).

infoLinks.urlText: Sutherland Shire bus changes for Sutherland 2 Surf event
infoLinks.content:
Sunday 19 July
  • From 7am to 10.45am, some route 969, 971, 975, 985 and 987 morning services will not run due to road closures in place for the Sutherland 2 Surf fun run event.

  • Services affected include:
    • Route 969: 8:10 service from Nullaburra Road, Caringbah to Miranda.
    • Route 971: 8:06 service from Cronulla to Miranda. The 8:45am service from Miranda will divert via Kiora Rd, President Av, Willarong Rd, Caringbah Rd, Port Hacking Rd and Burraneer Bay Rd
    • Route 975: 8:32 loop service from Miranda will now start at North West Arm Rd after President Ave (222748) at 08:41.
    • Route 985: 8:30 and 9:00 services from Cronulla to Miranda. Route 985 9:30 service from Miranda to Cronulla will now commence at 9:38 at Captain Cook Opp Sharks (2232185).
    • Route 987: 7:45 loop service. The 8:45 service will commence at Bridges St opposite Bridges St shops (223119) at Kurnell at 8:48. The 9:45 service from Cronulla Station will commence at Bridges St opp Bridges St Shops, Kurnell (223119) at 9.56 instead.
Bus customers should allow extra travel time and use alternative transport. Visit the Sutherland2Surf event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line weeknight partial closure due to maintenance
infoLinks.content:
On Wednesday 8 July, 8pm to 1am, L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line light rail services will not run between Westmead and Parramatta Square due to planned trackwork.
 
During this time, use alternative transport including L4 replacement bus services, trains, regular bus services or walking if able, between Westmead and Parramatta Square.
 
L4 replacement bus services:
  • Replacement bus services will run every 10 to 15 minutes from 8pm to 1am. These times may vary depending on road traffic.
  • Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:
    • Westmead Hospital (in both directions) - Please use the alternative stop at Westmead Station (approx. 6 minute walk)
    • Ngara (in both directions) - Please use the alternative stop at Benaud Oval (approx. 5 minute walk).
Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service. 
 
Where the replacement bus has an Opal reader onboard, you must tap on and tap off. A standard light rail fare applies.
 
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.
 
L4 light rail services will resume as normal from 5am Thursday 9 July.

infoLinks.urlText: Some trains run to a changed timetable. Buses replace some trains
infoLinks.content:
Friday 17 July 
  • The 13:16 Bomaderry to Kiama service runs 30 minutes earlier than the normal timetable, leaving Bomaderry at 12:46.
  • A replacement bus service leaves Bomaderry at 13:16, stopping all stations to Kiama, then express to Wollongong.
  • The 14:31 Bomaderry to Berry service runs 10 minutes later than the normal timetable, leaving Bomaderry at 14:41.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus route
61SC  Bomaderry, all stations to Kiama, Wollongong
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Hunter bus changes from Sunday 28 June
infoLinks.content:
From Sunday 28 June, we've made some changes to bus services in the Hunter.
  • The improvements are part of the Bus Service Uplift program, with an additional 32 services per week on Route 164 Cessnock to Maitland via Kurri Kurri operated by Rover Motors.
  • The increase to the bus network will see more night-time and weekend services for the region with buses to run hourly, seven days a week, servicing the growing communities of Gillieston Heights, Cliftleigh and Heddon Greta. 
  • Use Trip Planner to plan your journey.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction. Trains do not stop at Wolli Creek
infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 8 and Thursday 9 July
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction, but do not stop at Martin Place.
  • Most trains run to a changed timetable between Cronulla, Waterfall and the City Circle, with some making extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.
  • Change at:
    - Sydenham or Central for metro services to Martin Place
    - Central for buses to Kings Cross and Edgecliff
    - Town Hall for express buses to Bondi Junction.

  • Nightly from 10.10pm to 1.30am, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make an extra stop at Arncliffe.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek or change at Central for a T8 Airport & South Line train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
20T4  Bondi Junction, Edgecliff, Kings Cross, Central and return (bypassing Martin Place)
23T4  Bondi Junction, Town Hall and return
36T4  Arncliffe, Wolli Creek, Sydenham and return
324/325  City, Walsh Bay to Watsons Bay via Town Hall (Park St), Kings Cross, Edgecliff stations and return
333 City to Bondi Beach via Martin Place and Bondi Junction stations and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Additional afternoon school bus service for Lithgow and Hartley students
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 20 July, an additional temporary school bus will improve afternoon school bus journeys for the majority of students travelling between the upper Blue Mountains and Lithgow and Hartley. There are no changes to morning services. 
The school bus will service schools affected by the closure of the Great Western Highway at Victoria Pass.

Routes with changes:
 
S368 – Rosella Bus (afternoon service only)
S371 – Kookaburra Bus (afternoon service only)
S381 – Dragon bus (new route)
 
Read the news article at transportnsw.info for more information.
